decision.explanation: Both documents provide direct evidence that Pierre Sans attended both Stanford University (D1S1–D1S17) and Toulouse Capitole University (D2S1–D2S13). Document D1 states he earned a Ph.D. in Materials Science and Engineering from Stanford in 2005 and was affiliated with its Materials Science and Engineering Department. Document D2 confirms his enrollment at Toulouse Capitole University in the late 1990s and his affiliation with its Department of Sciences. These are distinct educational institutions and valid answers to the question.
